name: ippo_p_supplementary_s2_presslight_baseline
registration: internal, author-controlled, hash-locked; not externally registered
role: post-confirmation supplementary analysis; never merged into the frozen confirmatory test ippo_prior_confirmation_v1
question: How does IPPO-P compare against a published pressure-informed RL baseline implemented under the same environment, evaluation, and metric protocol?

baseline.name: PressLight (core-mechanism reproduction)
baseline.implementation: agents/presslight.py: Double-DQN with phase-pressure state, pressure reward; lightweight reproduction of the core PressLight mechanism inside this repo's harness
baseline.reporting_boundary: the paper must describe it as a core-mechanism reproduction under the same protocol, not the official PressLight/MPLight implementation; comparison figures are labelled same-harness reproductions, same as the constrained max-pressure descriptive variant

design.primary_metric: U (demand_service_time over 5 eval seeds, lower is better)
design.comparison: descriptive only: PressLight is an unpaired independent method; compare its per-scenario mean U with the archived IPPO and IPPO-P means; no confirmatory test claimed

decision_rule_primary: descriptive reporting of per-scenario mean U and per-seed values; no hypothesis test decides publication wording

presslight_comparable_or_better.condition: PressLight mean U within or better than IPPO-P in any scenario
presslight_comparable_or_better.conclusion_writing: report honestly; contextualize IPPO-P effect sizes against a published pressure-informed baseline; keep all claims descriptive

presslight_worse.condition: PressLight mean U worse than both IPPO and IPPO-P in all scenarios
presslight_worse.conclusion_writing: report honestly; note that the reproduction underperforms the on-policy agents in this harness, with the reproduction-scope caveat

mixed.conclusion_writing: report the per-scenario pattern as observed

anti_goals: no post-hoc tuning of the PressLight reproduction beyond its locked hyperparameters
no claim that results represent the official PressLight implementation
results never merged into the confirmatory test
